description:
A Native Scrobbler for Windows 11


Fluent Scrobbler — v1.1.0 Release Notes (2026-09-28)
Fluent Scrobbler v1.1.0 expands playback capabilities and social integrations with support for legacy Win32 media players, Discord Rich Presence, direct track favoriting, and seamless package management via Windows Package Manager.
Note
The 32-bit (x86) architecture distribution has been discontinued due to low adoption metrics. Existing users on 64-bit systems are advised to migrate to the x64 build.
New Features
- Discord Rich Presence: Integrates listening activity directly with Discord profiles, displaying live "Now Playing" track details and status updates in real time. #3
- Direct Track Favoriting: Adds an in-app like button to mark and synchronize loved tracks directly to the user's Last.fm library.
- Legacy Media Player Support: Enables tracking and scrobbling for classic Win32 desktop audio players, including Winamp, AIMP, and compatible window-based players. #2
- Settings Backup & Migration: Introduces quick import and export actions to simplify configuration backups and version upgrades.
- Winget Package Distribution: Adds official availability via Windows Package Manager for streamlined installation and automated updates:
winget install SnowMint.FluentScrobbler
Enchantments
- Album Art Resolution: Replaced the default Last.fm cover resolver with the public Deezer API to provide higher-fidelity and more consistent album artwork for active playback sessions.
- Installer Modernization: Upgraded the setup packaging framework from Inno Setup 6 to Inno Setup 7.
Bugs Fixeds
- Repeated Track Scrobbling: Resolved an issue in the duplicate prevention system that prevented consecutive scrobbles when looping tracks in repeat mode.
- Now Playing Synchronization: Fixed state inconsistencies for "Now Playing" tracking between the Home view and the Scrobbles view.
- Network Status Reliability: Replaced flaky NetworkInformation.GetInternetConnectionProfile connectivity checks that caused unexpected connection drops during stable internet access.
- Sync Cancellation Responsiveness: Resolved a UI lock issue where the "Sync Now" control stopped responding after an operation was canceled.
- Concurrent Instance Playback: Fixed an issue affecting simultaneous media playback tracking across multiple active player instances.
- Persistent InfoBar Dismissal: Fixed an issue where notification banners persisted for media sources that had already been dismissed.
Bug Reports & Support
Despite our best efforts to ensure a polished release, bugs may occasionally occur. If you encounter any issues, please open a bug report here
